summary: Gabelli Convertible & Income Securities Fund Inc filed an 8-K to disclose that Chairman and CIO Mario J. Gabelli was hospitalized on March 19, 2026, and GAMCO Investors activated its longstanding succession plan. Per the plan, Christopher J. Marangi became President of GAMCO, while day-to-day operations continue under co-CEO Douglas R. Jamieson. The portfolio management team is now led by Co-CIOs Kevin V. Dreyer and Marangi. The filing, made May 7, 2026, updates investors on management changes but provides no timeline for Gabelli’s return. The succession appears orderly, though the abrupt nature of the medical event constitutes a forced/abrupt departure for this context. Watch for further updates on Gabelli’s health and any impact on fund strategy or performance.
